svg.title: How enc_out is consumed inside one decoder layer's cross-attention
svg.desc: Zoomed view showing enc_out entering the cross-attention sub-layer, being projected through layer-specific K and V weights, and being matmul'd with the decoder's Q.
svg.text: Zoom: how enc_out is used inside one decoder layer
Inputs arriving at this decoder layer

g.text: Q, K, V all from x · tgt_mask
x' = self-attended target (same shape as x)

svg.text: Three nn.Linear projections happen here, each owned by THIS specific layer:
enc_out used twice — once for K, once for V
Output: per target position, a weighted sum of V (source values).

g.text: What about enc_out after this layer?
• enc_out itself is unchanged. The layer didn't mutate it.
• The same enc_out tensor will be passed to the NEXT decoder layer's cross-attention.
• That next layer has its OWN self.key and self.value linear weights, so it re-projects
enc_out differently — it might pull out different aspects of the source.
• Over 6 decoder layers, the same enc_out gets consulted 6 times, each time through
a different lens, contributing different information to the target stream.
